summary.zh: 从野性战斗拿护甲、躲闪与耐力，靠血之狂暴和自然反射回怒，再点满激怒，每次变熊都带着怒气开场。
summary.en: Armor, dodge, and Stamina from Feral Combat, rage from Blood Frenzy and Natural Reaction, and Furor so every shift into Bear Form starts with rage.

scenario.zh: 60 级在地下城与团本中以熊形态坦克
scenario.en: Level 60 bear tanking in dungeons and raids

pros.zh: 厚皮、野性之心与自然反射叠加护甲、20% 熊形态耐力和 5% 躲闪。
pros.en: Thick Hide, Heart of the Wild, and Natural Reaction stack armor, 20% Bear Form Stamina, and 5% dodge.

pros.zh: 血之狂暴与自然反射在暴击和躲闪时回复怒气，撕碎攻击降低割伤的怒气消耗。
pros.en: Blood Frenzy and Natural Reaction feed rage on critical strikes and dodges, and Shredding Attacks makes Lacerate cheaper.

pros.zh: 野性本能让挥击伤害提高 30%，方便同时拉住多个目标；狂暴让 Primal Bite 可击中 3 个目标且没有冷却。
pros.en: Feral Instinct raises Swipe damage by 30% for holding several targets; Berserk lets Primal Bite hit three targets with no cooldown.

pros.zh: 5 点激怒让你每次进入熊形态都获得 10 点怒气。
pros.en: Five points of Furor give 10 rage every time you shift into Bear Form.

pros.zh: 队伍需要更多打断时，可以把野性本能的点数换成野蛮冲撞，延长重击的昏迷时间。
pros.en: Brutal Impact adds a longer Bash stun if your group wants more interrupts; take it from Feral Instinct.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
